page.overview:
Who is Cinder Toad?

Cinder Toad, named Hinopio in the original game, is a supporting character in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars and its Nintendo Switch version.

Cinder Toad is a tall, muscular adult Toad who wears a black vest, sunglasses, and a beard and mustache, making him resemble a stereotypical biker. Cinder Toad's head is also black with red flame patterns on the underside, and he has a heart tattoo on his left shoulder.

Cinder Toad formerly lived at the Mushroom Kingdom, but moved to Barrel Volcano to run his own shop.

On the advice of Queen Nimbus, Mario and his party visit Cinder Toad before they proceed to face the Czar Dragon. Cinder Toad runs the Cinder Mart, which sells weapons and armor, and there is also a usable inn.
